entries.c2b2b830c9c53017: In its core business related to plastic molding, the company aims to expand market share through stronger competitiveness, including improving quality, meeting delivery deadlines and developing new products, and will focus on developing and expanding new sales areas such as batteries, food, cosmetics and chemicals by applying technology and know-how cultivated in plastic molding.
